performance.verdict: CPL collapse is real; but 10 overdue SOW milestones mean campaigns can't be judged fairly yet.

findings.text: 10 SOW milestones are overdue by 5–97 days: stack test, GHL migration, Meta CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences, and Phase 1 close — all past due.
CPL spiked 106.64% last 7d as spend rose 139.7% but leads grew only 16% — MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP ($669.98 of $786.72 28d spend) is scaling faster than conversion rate supports.
3-day signal (Oct 3–5): leads = 6, 0, 2 vs prior 3 days (Sep 30–Oct 2): leads = 6, 9, 2. Lead volume is flat-to-declining while spend held at $54/$35/$34 — efficiency erosion confirmed.
Spend was $0 on Sep 25–27 (3 consecutive zero-spend days) then resumed at $33–$54/day — a campaign pause mid-flight disrupts learning phase and likely contributed to CPL spike on restart.
GA4 shows 0 conversions across 2,496 sessions and 28 days; with landing pages flagged as overdue (F1), conversion tracking is almost certainly uninstalled — lead counts from Meta only.

suggestions.text: Cut MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP daily budget by 30% (~$13/day) until CPL returns to sub-$8 baseline.
suggestions.monday_update: MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP is spending $45/day while CPL has doubled to ~$12.75 (7d avg) versus the 28-day baseline of $6.19. Reduce its daily budget by approximately 30% — from ~$45 to ~$31/day — effective immediately. Success check: CPL returns below $8 within 7 days (by 2026-10-13). If CPL does not recover, escalate to audience tightening review.

suggestions.text: Install GA4 conversion tracking on landing pages — 0 conversions across 2,496 sessions is a blind spot blocking all attribution.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 has recorded 0 conversions across 2,496 sessions over 28 days, meaning every optimization decision is based on Meta-reported leads only with no independent verification. Landing pages are also flagged as an overdue SOW milestone (due 2026-07-31). Nacer/Web team to install and verify GA4 conversion events on all active landing pages. Success check: GA4 conversions > 0 and reconcilable with Meta leads within 7 days of page launch (target 2026-10-13).

suggestions.text: Watch lead recovery after budget trim Oct 3–9; do not scale until CPL holds below $8 for 3 consecutive days.
suggestions.monday_update: The 3-day lead signal (Oct 3–5) shows 8 leads at estimated CPL ~$15.49, well above the 28-day $6.19 baseline. The Sep 25–27 zero-spend pause likely disrupted Meta's learning phase and inflated CPL on restart. Hold at reduced budget and monitor daily CPL. Re-check on 2026-10-09: if CPL is below $8 for 3 consecutive days, green-light a 15% budget increase; if CPL remains elevated, bring to Sohib for audience strategy review.
